title: Integration by parts on a hypersurface that is stationary away from 0: ∫_M ∇^Mφ·∇^Mf = −∫_M φ Δ_Mf
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ, A₀ ⊆ ℝ^P a subspace with dim A₀ = m + 1, M ⊆ A₀ with 0 ∉ M, IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 1 m M, M Borel, H^m(M ∩ K) < ∞ for compact K, and M stationary away from 0 (∫_M trace(P_x∘DX(x)) dH^m = 0 for every C¹ X with compact support and 0 ∉ tsupport X); let ν : ℝ^P → ℝ^P be C^∞ on some open O ⊇ M, with ν(x) ∈ A₀, |ν(x)| = 1 and ν(x)·v = 0 for every v ∈ tangentSpace M x, for every x ∈ M; and assume (HL) the conclusion of the Lipschitz-approximation lemma for M (verbatim the conclusion of Submission.codim1_hcp_lipschitz_smooth_approx): (i) for every ζ locally Lipschitz on M and every j, x ↦ δ_jζ(x) is a.e. strongly measurable for H^m⌞M; (ii) for every ζ locally Lipschitz on M vanishing on M outside a compact C ⊆ M there are a compact C' ⊆ M and C^∞ compactly supported ζ_k vanishing on M ∖ C', with ζ_k → ζ uniformly on M and ∫⁻_M Σ_j (Dζ_k(x)(P_xe_j) − δ_jζ(x))² dH^m → 0. Throughout: P_y is the orthogonal projection onto span(tangentSpace M y), e_j = EuclideanSpace.single j 1, H^m = μHE[m], |A|²(y) := Σ_j |Dν(y)(P_ye_j)|² (Dν = fderiv ℝ ν), δ_jg(y) := fderivWithin ℝ g M y (P_ye_j). Let f, F : ℝ^P → ℝ and O' open with M ⊆ O', F C² on O' and F = f on M. Then for every φ locally Lipschitz on M vanishing on M outside a compact subset of M: x ↦ Σ_j δ_jφ(x)δ_jf(x) and x ↦ φ(x)·Σ_j δ_j(δ_jf)(x) are H^m⌞M-integrable, and ∫_M Σ_j δ_jφ δ_jf dH^m = −∫_M φ·Σ_j δ_j(δ_jf) dH^m.
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (A₀ : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (M : Set (Euclid P)) (ν : Euclid P → Euclid P), Module.finrank ℝ A₀ = m + 1 → M ⊆ (A₀ : Set (Euclid P)) → (0 : Euclid P) ∉ M → IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 1 m M → MeasurableSet M → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → μHE[m] (M ∩ K) ≠ ∞) → (∀ X : Euclid P → Euclid P, ContDiff ℝ 1 X → HasCompactSupport X → (0 : Euclid P) ∉ tsupport X → ∫ x in M, LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid P) ((Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M x)).starProjection.toLinearMap ∘ₗ (fderiv ℝ X x).toLinearMap) ∂μHE[m] = 0) → (∃ O : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen O ∧ M ⊆ O ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) ν O) → (∀ x ∈ M, ν x ∈ A₀ ∧ ‖ν x‖ = 1 ∧ ∀ v ∈ tangentSpace M x, inner ℝ (ν x) v = 0) → ((∀ (ζ : Euclid P → ℝ), LocallyLipschitzOn M ζ → ∀ j : Fin P, AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x => fderivWithin ℝ ζ M x ((Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M x)).starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single j 1))) (μHE[m].restrict M)) ∧ ∀ (ζ : Euclid P → ℝ), LocallyLipschitzOn M ζ → (∃ C : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact C ∧ C ⊆ M ∧ ∀ x ∈ M, x ∉ C → ζ x = 0) → ∃ (C' : Set (Euclid P)) (ζs : ℕ → Euclid P → ℝ), IsCompact C' ∧ C' ⊆ M ∧ (∀ k, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (ζs k) ∧ HasCompactSupport (ζs k)) ∧ (∀ k, ∀ x ∈ M, x ∉ C' → ζs k x = 0) ∧ TendstoUniformlyOn ζs ζ atTop M ∧ Tendsto (fun k => ∫⁻ x in M, ENNReal.ofReal (∑ j : Fin P, (fderiv ℝ (ζs k) x ((Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M x)).starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)) - fderivWithin ℝ ζ M x ((Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M x)).starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single j 1))) ^ 2) ∂μHE[m]) atTop (𝓝 0)) → ∀ (f F : Euclid P → ℝ) (O' : Set (Euclid P)), IsOpen O' → M ⊆ O' → ContDiffOn ℝ 2 F O' → (∀ y ∈ M, F y = f y) → ∀ φ : Euclid P → ℝ, LocallyLipschitzOn M φ → (∃ C : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact C ∧ C ⊆ M ∧ ∀ x ∈ M, x ∉ C → φ x = 0) → Integrable (fun x => ∑ j : Fin P, fderivWithin ℝ φ M x ((Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M x)).starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)) * fderivWithin ℝ f M x ((Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M x)).starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single j 1))) (μHE[m].restrict M) ∧ Integrable (fun x => φ x * ∑ j : Fin P, fderivWithin ℝ (fun y => fderivWithin ℝ f M y ((Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M y)).starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single j 1))) M x ((Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M x)).starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single j 1))) (μHE[m].restrict M) ∧ ∫ x in M, (∑ j : Fin P, fderivWithin ℝ φ M x ((Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M x)).starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)) * fderivWithin ℝ f M x ((Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M x)).starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single j 1))) ∂μHE[m] = -(∫ x in M, φ x * (∑ j : Fin P, fderivWithin ℝ (fun y => fderivWithin ℝ f M y ((Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M y)).starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single j 1))) M x ((Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M x)).starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single j 1))) ∂μHE[m])
